# CampusSignal — Official LLM Reference & Context
> The personalized discovery and broadcast layer for St. Xavier\'s University, Kolkata (SXUK) and pan-India collegiate ecosystems.

CampusSignal is a mobile-first and web application engineered to consolidate fragmented campus communications—including hackathons, campus recruitment drives, academic conferences, cultural fests, workshops, and society circulars—into a low-latency, personalized broadcast feed.

- **Production Custom Domain**: https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/
- **Institution**: St. Xavier\'s University, Kolkata (SXUK), Action Area III, New Town, Kolkata 700160, WB, India
- **Application Architecture**: Flutter 3 (Android/iOS) + Material 3 Expressive (M3E) + Supabase (Postgres & RLS) + Cloudflare R2 + Google Gemini 2.5 Multimodal Vision OCR.

## Primary Routes & Page Slugs
- [Landing & Showcase](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/): Production overview, live signal simulation, architecture, and feature demos.
- [Download APK Hub](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/download/): Split-ABI release downloads (ARM64-v8a, ARMeabi-v7a, x86_64, Universal) with SHA-256 checksums.
- [Opportunity Feed Web App](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/app/): Real-time personalized opportunity feed with department filtering, instant search, and event modals.
- [Calendar & Deadlines](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/app/calendar/): Academic calendar with conflict detector and `.ics` semester export.
- [AI Flyer Studio](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/app/studio/): Multimodal OCR engine parsing event posters into structured JSON.
- [Broadcast Notifications](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/app/notifications/): High-priority campus signals and urgent registration alarms.
- [Saved Bookmarks](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/app/saved/): Bookmarked opportunities and calendar sync items.
- [Academic Profile](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/app/profile/): SXUK department, degree programme, semester, and skill tags.
- [Sign In Portal](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/auth/): Google OAuth, SXUK Email OTP, and Instant Guest Demo Preview.
- [Student Onboarding](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/onboarding/): Two-step academic department and interest personalization wizard.
- [Privacy Policy](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/privacy/): DPDP Act 2023 compliance, student data sovereignty, and zero-ad telemetry policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://campussignal.sxuk.edu.in/terms/): Community broadcast guidelines and fair use policies.

## Academic Scope
CampusSignal natively maps all 28 degree programmes at St. Xavier\'s University, Kolkata across:
1. Faculty of Science & Technology (B.Tech CSE, AI&ML, ECE, IT; B.Sc Data Science; M.Sc Computer Science, M.Sc Statistics).
2. Faculty of Commerce & Management (B.Com Hons, B.M.S Hons, M.Com, Ph.D. in Commerce & Management).
3. Faculty of Arts & Humanities (B.A. English, Economics, Mass Communication, Psychology; M.A., M.S.W., Ph.D.).
4. Xavier Law School (B.A. LL.B., B.Com. LL.B., LL.M., Ph.D.).

## Key Technologies
- **Multimodal AI**: Google Gemini 2.5 Vision OCR extracts event titles, dates, deadlines, registration URLs, eligibility criteria, and venues from unstructured posters.
- **Storage**: Cloudflare R2 bucket (`campussignal-media`) provides zero-egress asset delivery.
- **Sync**: Native `.ics` iCalendar calendar synchronization and FCM push notifications.
- **Privacy**: Compliant with India\'s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023.
